scripts.pack:shared: npm run build:shared && npm_config_cache=/tmp/terse-npm-cache npm pack -w terse-types --dry-run
scripts.publish:shared: npm run build:shared && npm_config_cache=/tmp/terse-npm-cache npm publish -w terse-types --access public
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w terse-sdk && npm run build -w terse-cli
scripts.link:cli: npm run build:packages && npm link --workspace terse-cli
scripts.link:packages: npm run build:packages && npm link --workspace terse-sdk && npm link --workspace terse-cli
scripts.python:check: ./.venv/bin/ruff check packages/terse-python-sdk/src packages/terse-python-sdk/tests && ./.venv/bin/ruff format --check packages/terse-python-sdk/src packages/terse-python-sdk/tests && ./.venv/bin/ty check packages/terse-python-sdk/src && npm run python:test
scripts.python:fix: ./.venv/bin/ruff check --fix packages/terse-python-sdk/src packages/terse-python-sdk/tests && ./.venv/bin/ruff format packages/terse-python-sdk/src packages/terse-python-sdk/tests
scripts.python:build: npm run python:dist:clean && uv build --package terse-sdk
scripts.python:dist:check: npm run python:build && uvx twine check dist/terse_sdk-*
scripts.python:publish: npm run python:dist:check && uvx twine upload dist/terse_sdk-*
